notes.title: patch note 5/4
notes.content:
Optimizations and fixes:
Fixed the problem of falling speed caused by upgrading the engine
Optimized weapon shooting sound effects and special effects
Optimized shotgun reloading logic
Fixed the issue of missing horse models in story mode after upgrading the engine

New content:

notes.title: patch note 2/27
notes.content:
Optimization: 
Optimize the calculation method after enemy death to reduce system computation. 
Upgraded the game engine to the Longterm Serve version to prepare for long-term maintenance in the future and fixed several bugs caused by the upgrade 
Optimized the level loading method to ensure the information correctly after each level update 
Replaced grenade model

New features: 
1. Add the TNT explosion function and some TNT objects to the scene 
2. Added the "Last Weapon used" record. Every time you enter the scene, the character will default pull out the last gun. 
3. Add a female voice

notes.title: Future update plan
notes.content:
Hi cowboy,
Long time no see. Sorry I didn't launch the Lord Mode in time. I'm not going to say some excuses but update more contents in the future and let these new contents to express my sorry to you guys.

notes.title: Update v0.3.8.0 now live!
notes.content:
Hello Cowboys,
Finally, the new update 0.3.8 is now playable.
The brand new DLC "realistic map" is being reviewed by steam, should also be playable within 2-3 days.

[h1][b]Story Mode:[/b][/h1]
Completed story line and all levels with story animation film.
(4 new levels, and 10 new animations)
The story mode is the mainly updated mode in this update. As you can see in the screenshot, all levels are now able to play. I can't say too much story details here, if you're interested in this mode, go ahead and play the game.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33429835/a886b04def44b7306992982d2584ab32639f7012.jpg[/img]

Also it's worth mention that I remade all levels description and the animations start by Lv3. Personally I suggest playing this mode from Lv3 at least if you would like to see the whole story-line. 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33429835/a63e4283dd46acd77405270310bd2c7070f7ea02.jpg[/img]
Basically, all levels now have animation films.

[h1][b]Quick Mode:[/b][/h1]
One new map added. It's a bigger town which also being used in the story mode.
There is a new "Train" level in the story mode, however due to lack of spawn points, I didn't add that map into quick mode.

[h1][b]Endless Mode:[/b][/h1]
A new map which has a little different landscape style. 
This map also linked the terrains of Lv3 and Lv4.
(someone might have seen part it by jumping across the air wall)
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33429835/ab92481934d3cdcb111ec65e8cccf858bbc0c756.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Minigames:[/b][/h1]
A new minigame: Chicken Dinner.
Inspire by "Flying saucer shooting"
See how many chickens you can shoot down within 1 minutes.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33429835/59889e3c97d5c4063306c6d2a101c9e3b11fbbca.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Function improvement:[/b][/h1]
[h1]1. Steam Clouds[/h1]
Now you can use steam clouds to share your scores and upgrading data through different computers and won't worry about losing them.
[h1]2. Steam Leaderborad[/h1]
Add button which allow players see their own rank and ranks around them.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33429835/8a5be231ac9e835991ea138573834086c21960e2.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]DLC:  Bonus Realistic Map[/b][/h1]
A free bonus map to thank players for all your supports.
It's now being reviewed by Steam and can be played once been approved. Usually it takes 2 to 3 days.
This DLC currently contain one map playable. Will adding few more maps in the future development.
I will post another blog to introduce more detail about the DLC after it releasing.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33429835/3557e2f1c95d2bc0048e63f543b9b0a9e02e369a.jpg[/img]

Thanks for all your supports to this game. The game is still in the EA stage, and there will be more updates in the future.

notes.title: About new upcoming update and realistic version
notes.content:
Hello Cowboys,

It's been a while since last blog posted. I was planning to update the game by the end of April, however, making the realistic version really cost me more unexpected times due to lack of experience of unreal engine 4.

Today I'm going to intro the upcoming content and future plan about this game. 

[b]About new update:[/b]
The next update v0.3 will be playable on the next week. This update is mainly focus on content fill for existing mode, especially for [b]Story Mode[/b]. There is no new mode on this update but will have new maps for each mode and new mini-game. so, whether which mode you like, you will find new contents there. 
I will post another blog about detail for the update once it's online.

[b]When will the realistic version playable:[/b]
And for those people who waiting for realistic version, I'm glad to tell you the first version will release very soon. (within this month).
I have finished all the basic parts such as controller and AI, and some features like dynamic sky which make the game looks even better. I'm now looking for some decent character models and impact particles to replace the demo ones. Once the art asset replacements are finished, I will run a quick test to make sure it plays smoothly for the most current-gen graphic card.

[b]How to play realistic version[/b]
The realistic version will come as a [b]Free [/b]DLC. The reason why I do this is mainly because this version would cost much more space for the hard-drive. So if it comes as a DLC, you can easily choose whether install it or not instead of install bunch of content anyway. Also the hardware requirement is different. I will do my best try to optimize it, but still you cannot expect some very old graphic card can run the current-gen environment. 


That's all I got today. As always, if you have any question or suggestion, please leave a reply in the comments section. The discussion boards are also welcome.
Wish you best and good luck.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33429835/3640aa578d90e7c8a32e96eba0bd21ee08828c75.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Update Beta v0.2.1.0 is now live!(Mar. 11)
notes.content:
Hello Cowboys,
The new big update is coming, I'm working on the final testing to make sure there is no crucial bug. (Update: It' will be playable on March 11th with 33% weeklong discount).

Quick Mode:
Two new maps
One for native American style, one for forest camp.
The feature of these two maps is they both lack of big cover, so they are harder.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33429835/26ca66e7fb4dfccd2be02f6ee96199dd60dffc32.jpg[/img]

Mini-games Mode:
New west duel game.
This game is mainly inspired by the old NES(FC) game “Wild Gunman”. Player need to fellow the west duel rule and try to win a glorious victory.
(and thanks to players who suggest me add this mini-game)
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33429835/18c3190327d93b1f68a8e30b7c02fd95b0f32063.jpg[/img]

New mode:
Endless mode. A brand-new mode contains items dropping system which is also main content for this update. There is more detail intro about this mode later in this blog. 

Function improvements:
1. Custom key binding system. Now player can freely bind their own keys on the setting panel.
2. Auto/Hand Take cover option. According players’ feedback, players now can choose whether automatically taking cover or not. The default will still be “auto”. If you switch to by hand then the default button is key “C”, also you can adjust your own prefer key.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33429835/37c678120c028ef5a6784df6a81237dde8ef2566.jpg[/img]


Next is the detail introduction about the new Endless Mode: 
Gameplay:
In this mode, you play the game in a much bigger map than other mode. In the beginning, the map will generate some fighting areas. Once you step into that area, a new fighting start. The endless mode provides a new fighting gameplay: Dropping items, no health regeneration, limited bullets. Fighting areas will keep refresh until the player dead or chose to leave.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33429835/3b5de81932d82b321652da19ec23b3db3f83ba0e.jpg[/img]

Items:
Here are 4 items for now, I will keep add more in the future.
1.Heath
Add 30% heath once picked up.
2.Bullets
All weapons get a magazine of bullets
3.Accurate
Player get 300% speed for a while.
4. Shield
Players gain 5 seconds of invincibility
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33429835/33fb681e5b7b4f7c9fd71160d3681719eea6d6bd.jpg[/img]

Other function:
Riding system
Long press “E” to ride the horse, and also long press “E” to leave.
Leaderboard
The mode will have an independent steam leaderboard, but your upgrades in the camp will still be applied in this mode. 

The new mode has just been finished, and there may be some serious bugs. If you meet any problems, please feel free to let me know. I’ll fix it as soon as possible.

I know someone is waiting for the realistic style version. I have finished the player controller part for that version. Still lots works need to do, such as AI. Hope I can release the first demo for realistic version by the end of next month. I will let you guys know the developing progress.

notes.title: Update Info Beta v0.1.1.8
notes.content:
Hi cowboys,

After receiving two days of feedback, I fixed and adjusted some of the features.
This update is mainly to fix the existing problems and adjust the balance of the game. 
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Adjustment:

Weapon: (The main adjustment goal is to make each gun useful, instead of sniper world)
Increase pistol damage
Increase Thompson damage
Reduce the recoil of the Thompson
Increase shotgun damage
Reduce shotgun shooting range
Reduce sniper damage

Other:
Increase player health recovery speed
Adjust the quick mode start animation speed
Reduce shooting bullet sound in the quick mode
Raise the price of snipers in bounty hunters
Significantly reduce the enemy's time to track players, now as long as you hide well, some of the enemy will give up looking for you.
Adjust part of the map terrain
Add a description of the grenade in the tutorial
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
The following issues have been fixed:

After completing the game and uploading the score, player can restart by not cost the bounty hunter again.
The cursor occasionally hides after the game is over
After the player dies, the bounty hunter kills the enemy and still shows victory.
Some walls and doors don't have collision
The window changes back to the full screen when start a game.
Choosing a enter point in the quick mode sometimes get stuck.
Bullet shot particle display does not correspond to actual shooting effect
The 2nd level of story mode don't have sniper scope.
Part of the maps computer path finding out of range
Quick mode setting difficulty and wave, etc. directly return to the scene, resulting in no data reset
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
New Content Added:

Increase the ally outline, now the friendly will display a green outline to facilitate identification of the enemy
Quick mode adds a reset button
Add end animation for 2nd level of story mode
Increase the automatic pop-up function of the tutorial, the first time you run the game will pop up the tutorial
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
This update has not yet implemented all feedback, and some of the feedback added to the plan will be implemented in the next update. More new content will be added in the next update.
Please feel free to contact me if you have any questions or suggestions.
Thanks to all the players who gave feedback and suggestions for these two days! You made this game better.

notes.title: Releasing date and the future update plan
notes.content:
Hi cowboys,
After months developments, the game is going to release.
The releasing date is Dec.25.

For now, the game mainly finished Quick Mode. The Story Mode and the Mini-games Mode still needs many future developments.
Since the game is still in EA stage, you might meet bugs. If you did, please tell me. I'd fix them as soon as possible, you can leave message on the discussion board. 

Next let's talk about future update plan. First, I'd like to say although I'm the only dev who is developing this game right now, I'm a guy who take making games as my life time career. Any game I release on Steam, including this game, will be updated for a long time. You can expect new content update even after buying the game for years.

Here is my to do list of updates:
Quick Mode: Add more maps
Story Mode: Polish the animation between levels, add boss fight, and complete the story line.
Mini-games: western duel monopoly, chicken tonight.
Other:
1. New mode (maybe a roguelike survival mode, not decided yet)
2. Add Steam achievements after the content is relatively complete.

If you have any suggestion, please feel free to put them on the discussion board. I will consider your suggestion.

Thanks for your playing and have a good time!

notes.title: Game mode intro: Quick Mode
notes.content:
Greetings cowboys,
Starting from today, I will post some dev blogs to introduce contents of the game and what I have added recently.
For now, the game has three modes: Quick mode, Story mode and the mini-games mode. First please let me intro the quick mode.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33429835/2c44d22b0cdaf10bc5171bbfb5b049804df9d6cd.png[/img]
As I said in the store page, the inspiration for making the "Take That" is I want to play a shooting game without so many complicated processes or storytelling. Some online shooting games such as CS don't have such things, but pvp sometimes can be very frustrating. 
Here comes out this quick mode fit my goal.

[h1]Features of quick mode[/h1][list]
[*] It can be started within seconds
[*] Three difficulties for each map
[*] Maximum 5 extra waves 
[*] Three enter-points can be chosen
[*] Hire bounty hunters to help you
[/list]

For each enter-point, you can arrange up to three bounty hunters. 
After earning some rewards, you can go to camps to hire them. 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33429835/031fa438db677efe6af1187a03e2531f560dfec2.png[/img]
They use different types of weapon and have different characteristics. 
If you just need someone to attract attention and block the bullet for you, the gambler would be a nice choice. If you need a real shooter, hire the snipers, they are very deadly. 
(price for hiring each type could be changed, the balance is still in testing)

You might notice there is also an Upgrade button in the screenshot, basically, it's another place you can spend your money on camps, you can upgrade some basic abilities there. I will intro more detail about that in the feature.

Overall, I try to make this mode can be started very quickly, but also interesting. Next time I will talk about the story mode. 
Hope you enjoyed this blog. If you have any question or suggestion, please leave a reply in the comments section. The discussion boards are also welcome.
